name: com.gatongone.gneedle.aspect
description: Gneedle.Aspect is the aspect weaver of Gneedle: an IL post processor, which the compilation pipeline runs on an assembly as it is compiled, before it is written and loaded. It applies the injectors which the assembly declares, and an injector is an attribute which implements one of the interfaces of Gneedle.Inject and says what to do with the member it is put on. The attributes, and the reference to the weaver which they name, are taken back out of the assembly once they have been applied.
